# Human Emotional Atlas

HEA is a CC0 descriptive emotional reference dataset. It is not an inference engine or behavioral policy.

Repository: https://github.com/d4rkd0s/human-emotional-atlas
Read: README.md and docs/DATA_MODEL.md
Canonical data: data/states.json, data/relations.json, data/sources.json
Built website data: data/manifest.json, data/atlas.json
Building this repository: AGENTS.md
Progress and release status: MILESTONES.md

Use files from one revision. Follow source scope, conditions, counterexamples, and alternative interpretations. Unmerged PR data is provisional. Empty main data is intentional until maintainer review. Consumers make their own determinations.
